name: Heaven's Rejects
source:
Jersey, supernatural bureau slack-off and half-demon, has just been assigned a new partner, an angel and star agent named Constantine. Catch up with their misadventures in the Ren'Py novella, Heaven’s Rejects. 

[From [url=https://smarted-pants.itch.io/heavens-rejects]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Jersey是超自然事務局裡一個懶散的半惡魔，最近剛被分配了一位新搭檔：名叫Constantine的天使，也是局裡的明星幹員。來看看他們在Ren'Py短篇視覺小說《Heaven's Rejects》中的種種冒險。

[來源：[url=https://smarted-pants.itch.io/heavens-rejects]Itch.io[/url]]
